algorithms.name: A* search (Dijkstra + haversine heuristic)
algorithms.role: shortest path over the road graph (nodes=intersections, edges=streets weighted by length)

combination: A* finds the path -> distance_km; ETA ML gives eta_min; Fare ML gives fare_usd; polyline returned for the map
flow: return polyline + metrics to the app map
data_source: free OpenStreetMap via build_city_graph.py -> city_graph.json (no paid Maps API)
image_prompt: Draw a clean left-to-right flowchart for the RideIQ 'Routing' feature. Show input fields entering a box of ML models running in parallel, their outputs combined into a single result, then returned to the Android app as JSON. Flat modern style, rounded boxes, labeled arrows. A road-network graph with an A* shortest path highlighted between two pins, feeding distance into ETA and Fare model boxes, returning a polyline to the phone map.
